_meta.description: Dynamic knowledge base for the interview copilot. Pre-filled for Google Cloud FDE II interview.

session.tone: senior engineer explaining to a peer
constraints: REASON about the question first — what are they really asking? Then formulate a cohesive answer
Use candidate experience as SUPPORTING EVIDENCE, not the answer itself — cite specifics only when directly relevant
DO NOT dump resume bullets — synthesize a narrative that addresses the question's core intent
Match technical depth to the question — if they ask 'how', explain the approach; if they ask 'tell me about', tell a story
Each bullet should flow logically into the next — not be an isolated resume line item

interviewers.background: Senior Google FDE specializing in GenAI enterprise deployments. 8+ years at Google. Expects production-grade thinking, not theoretical answers.
priorities: GCA: structured analytical decomposition — clarify constraints before solving, present 2-3 options with tradeoffs, surface failure modes unprompted

interviewers.style_notes: Expects clarify-first approach on every scenario. Probes for failure modes. Wants measurable outcomes. Will ask 'what specifically did YOU do?' if answer uses 'we'.
